note: No parish-wide contest or proposition is on the Jefferson Parish ballot: parish government offices were elected in 2023, and the District Attorney (24th JDC), Juvenile Court Sections A-C and most 24th JDC divisions were unopposed and do not appear on the ballot. Not shown (they depend on a district or section the address lookup cannot resolve): Judge, 24th Judicial District Court, Election Section 2, Division F; Judge, 1st Parish Court, Divisions A and B (east bank); School Board districts; State Representative District 92; Justice of the Peace and Constable; City of Harahan offices; Public Service Commission District 1 and BESE District 1. City of Gretna voters: the Fire millage (8.5 mills) is on the ballot only in precincts G-001 through G-011 (it excludes the annexed Timberlane parts of G-012 and G-013), so it is not shown. Kenner has no citywide item on this ballot. Check your official sample ballot for these.

measures.title: City of Gretna (Ambulance) - 4.00 Mills - CC - 10 Yrs.
measures.summary: Authorizes the City of Gretna to levy a special property tax of 4.00 mills for ten years, 2028 through 2037, to provide ambulance service within the city. The tax is estimated to raise about $683,939 per year.
measures.yesMeans: Gretna may levy a 4.00-mill property tax for ambulance service from 2028 through 2037.
measures.noMeans: Gretna may not levy this 4.00-mill ambulance tax.

measures.title: City of Gretna (Police) - 8.00 Mills - CC - 10 Yrs.
measures.summary: Authorizes the City of Gretna to levy a special property tax of 8.00 mills for ten years, 2028 through 2037, to maintain existing City Police Department manpower levels. The tax is estimated to raise about $1,367,879 per year.
measures.yesMeans: Gretna may levy an 8.00-mill property tax for police staffing from 2028 through 2037.
measures.noMeans: Gretna may not levy this 8.00-mill police tax.
